Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We will not move forward with your application because your CV does not meet the following must-have requirements: 5 years of software development experience. Additionally, you do not have experience with Machine Learning or algorithms development, which are required nice-to-have skills.

Kind regards
